# Campaign Channel Discovery

- Discovery is operator-triggered background work, single-flighted per campaign; the operator names the accounts that read (`account_ids`, required — the server no longer auto-picks the listener). Reservation is all-or-nothing: every picked account is checked, then locked in sorted id order under warming's per-account lifecycle lock and re-asked from BOTH owners inside it (the resolution is several awaits old by then); the first failing account refuses the whole start and is named in the outcome. Warming, the listener and a run exclude each other symmetrically; a neuroshilling campaign sits outside that circle. Do not hold the lifecycle locks across the run.
- The reserved accounts form one pool ordered Premium-first (a non-premium account genuinely receives FLOOD_PREMIUM_WAIT and gets a tenth of the recommendations). Every read — waves and qualification probes — takes the next account round-robin; an account that floods, cools or fails `discovery_max_consecutive_errors` times in a row leaves the pool and the run continues on the rest; the wave stops only when the pool is empty, labelled by the reason the last account left. Health is re-read from the in-process cooldown before every read, never from Telegram. Reads stay sequential: no fan-out, the shared budget and merge order assume one stream.
- Sources: keyword search, the global post search (paged, narrower than its docs suggest), recommendations for the operator's seed and for the sweep's best hits. A chosen category appends its word bundle to the sweep. `kind` is honored at the gateway (channels flag / groups flag) and by post-filter on recommendations; `hide_seen` and `limit` are applied in the merge (seen = every channel a stored run ever wrote, global across campaigns, table `neurocomment_discovery_seen`). `language`, `comments`, `access` open-vs-join-request and `category` need `about` from GetFullChannel, so they act at qualification and a rejected row is DELETED, never stored hidden; counts land in the run report's `filtered`. Unknown values never reject. A username-less recommendation is stored as `id:<channel_id>` with access `subscription`, never probed and never adoptable; groups are shown but `not_adoptable` (the listener ignores non-post messages). Subscriber bounds apply once counts are known, never to recommendation seeds; a hit admitted uncounted carries a flag. An unresolvable seed is a refusal, never an empty answer.
- A run's waves share one read budget of `discovery_max_reads_per_run × pool size`, spent in wave order (keywords → the operator's seed → post pages → recommendations); the operator's seed is one read and does not queue behind an automatic wave; recommendation reads are held back before the post pages. The post wave caps its own total. Truncation is reported and is NOT a run error. The rolling-24h search allowance is separate. Wave shape below the budget is a module literal, not a setting.
- Whether a read failure is a rate limit is the gateway's `kind`, never the reason text; a limit with no duration takes the configured no-duration cooldown.
- Merge interleaves per OUTCOME, not per source, before the cap: source priority decides dedup spelling, not which source fills the cap.
- Every source reports `ran`/`failed`/`skipped`; `hits` are DISTINCT usable channels. Replace stored candidates only when at least one source answered; an EMPTY result additionally needs the keyword sweep itself to have answered. A rate-limited, cut-short run never displaces the stored set. Per-run progress, provenance and verdict fields (access, language, category match) are ephemeral across restart; only `kind` and the seen table are persisted.
- Qualification is resumable and stops Telegram work when the pool is empty. The fresh-cache shortcut is skipped when a language or category filter is active (they need a fresh `about`).
- Keyword suggestion is a convenience beside the box, not part of a run: no campaign, no account, no Telegram read; single WORDS (the SPA tokenises on whitespace and commas); DeepSeek only; an unusable answer is a 200 carrying a code.
